Evelinn is a beautiful Greek girl name with rich cultural and religious significance. Derived from the Greek word ‘evos’, which means ‘life’ or ‘youth’, this name carries the essence of new beginnings and fresh energy. In Christianity, Evelinn can be associated with the biblical story of Eve, the first woman created by God, whose name means ‘life’ in Hebrew.
